newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: RESEARCH ALERT - Thakral rated outperform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Thakral rated outperform.

text.p: Thakral Corporation Ltd has been rated an outperform stock by Vickers Ballas Securities a its latest research report issued on Thursday.

In a report dated July 17, when Thakral was at US$1.07, Vickers said the company, which distributes and produces electronic consumer products in China, had a well established distribution base throughout China.
It said heathly consumer demand was expected on the back of improving macro-economic fundamentals in China.
Vickers has projected that Thakral's three-year compounded annual growth rate will be 15 percent through to financial year 2000, driven by the distribution segment.
It said valuations were undemanding based on a price earnings ratio of 10.9 times based on 1998 earnings, going down to 8.2 times in 2000.
